findings.finding: The root nav opens /today/ as the new 24 October board but still labels /cadence/ 'Current' and keeps a 23 October stripe and a 23 October hero. Readers can mistake the older picks for today's. The two scopes should be clearly labelled without editing an active integration owner's files.

The 96 imported OLBG records plus one first-hand Hurling record are first-page extracts, not a complete sport inventory. Interleaved promo cards and Load More Tips prevent an exhaustive list without pagination capture.

NBA games page failed but the 1pm ET official injury report names eight NBA matchups and tip times. Treat its player-status extract cautiously: row spans and NOT YET SUBMITTED are not a clean injury feed.

A fair -250…+10000 calculation is not an observed OLBG price. The NHL league feed does supply a distinct FanDuel partnerId=7 quote for some moneylines; show both separately and never substitute tip support percentages for a probability.
A dated desk stays on GitHub Pages after events start. A clean root needs a visible as-of timestamp and browser-time expiry warning; a successful build or deploy does not refresh the evidence.
Historical merge separators and conflict markers remain in the shared task board; they are prior records, not introduced by this session.

Legacy scope note says Greyhounds and Gaelic Football are excluded despite the current explicit 15-sport request including both. Older 17-sport desks additionally show eSports/Aussie Rules; keep them historical and out of the current shortlist.

OLBG NOP@DEN and GSW@PHX displayed times are one hour later than the NBA's 1pm ET report; its South Africa v Australia row is dated the third Test's final day, not the CSA-confirmed 27 Oct start. Times cannot be silently used as official UTC.

The separate /today/ source transcript spells Flyers leader 'Michael Michkov'. The NHL 24 Oct game leader object identifies Matvei Michkov with six goals. Vantage uses Matvei and records the older transcript as a typo, without changing another session's files.
